scope: XMemAllocDefault/XMemFreeDefault ordinary CPU partition-heap attribute routing; non-heap Xbox page and partition paths remain unsupported. TuxBox uses the process heap as CPU backing.
native_method: Runs the hash-pinned supplied routines in a temporary mapped PE, using controlled XbGetPartitionHeap, HeapAlloc and HeapFree stubs. Forty input attributes cover allocation-type values 0..4, lower metadata fields, and high attribute bits. Verifies actual routing, flags, size and pointer on allocation and free.
guest_checks: Allocate and free 17-byte blocks with all 40 attribute cases through both the default and hooked entry points. Verify host heap membership, 16-byte alignment and writable contents.
Test zero-valued attributes, including the case previously rejected, and reject an unsupported page-alignment profile.
limits: The supplied console DLL partition heap calls are stubbed in the native control; real console heap, tracking callbacks and allocation-failure behavior are not compared.
Higher alignment modes, other selector values, allocation types and GPU/partition behaviors remain unsupported.
Default XMemFree on null is currently a no-op, unlike the original heap dispatch; null free error details remain unverified.
